_comment: CI's floor for the evaluation replay (quality.yml): the committed replies replay deterministically, so these are today's numbers and any change to the shared post-processing that reads them worse fails. Raise them when a change reads better; lower one only with the reason in the pull request. Units match exactly after clinical normalisation since 2026-11-09 (a cut-off unit no longer counts), which read LDL's 'mg/dL (calc)' as wrong until the shared post-processing dropped printed notes from units (2026-11-09): 76 values, 62 LOINC, 1 extra number, no wrong value unflagged. Two reports joined on 2026-11-09 for the row layouts the unit check must not mistake (en_cumulative_flags: a previous-result column behind a written-out flag, two tests a line with the unit in each label; de_einheit_vorn: the unit column first): 96 values, 81 LOINC, 9 dates; extra numbers went from 1 to 2 because the model read en_cumulative_flags' WBC 11.8 as 111.8, which the source check flags. The planted* numbers are the errors planted in the right readings (evaluation/.../PlantedErrors.kt): the set mustn't shrink, and no more may slip through, in total and of each kind (plantedByKind: planted at least, notFlagged = planted - flagged at most), so one kind reading worse can't hide behind another reading better.
